outcome: miRNA expression levels in blood plasma
cohort: Pregnant women with early- and late-onset preeclampsia and a control group
finding: Several miRNAs showed altered expression levels in both the placenta and blood plasma of pregnant women with preeclampsia compared to the control group, suggesting their potential as early biomarkers for preeclampsia.
gest_age: 11-13 weeks (for miR-423-5p analysis), 28-33 weeks (for clinical manifestation)
